title: Document the Conversation Call system (audio/video calls) as a shipped 2.1 Conversation-mode capability
description: Skill says: architecture.md Conversation Mode bullet list (lines 80-90) enumerates schedules, statuses, talkativeness, selfies, memory commands, scenes, and UNO turn-games but is entirely SILENT on calls. Reality (2.1): Conversation chats gained a full call system - a global gate `callAudioEnabled` (default false) plus per-chat opt-in, character-initiated incoming calls, a Discord-style desktop/mobile call surface, call-only chat, speaking highlights, mute/camera/screen-share, soundboard, minimized active-call popouts, call history cards, and post-call summary injection (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added; server registers `conversationCallsRoutes` at prefix `/api/conversation-calls`, packages/server/src/routes/index.ts:89; gate + controls in packages/shared/src/types/tts.ts:135-152). Fix: add a 'Conversation Calls' subsection under Conversation Mode in architecture.md listing these features and the enable path (Settings TTS `callAudioEnabled` global gate + per-chat toggle).

title: Add the /api/conversation-calls route family to the API Surface list
description: Skill says: architecture.md 'API Surface (Key Endpoints)' (lines 142-162) lists conversation/scene/game/turn-games routes but has no calls route. Reality (2.1): a new router is registered at `/api/conversation-calls` (packages/server/src/routes/index.ts:89) exposing (packages/server/src/routes/conversation-calls.routes.ts): `GET /chat/:chatId/status` (2245), `POST /start` (2446), `POST /:id/accept` (2493), `POST /:id/decline` (2528), `POST /:id/end` (2554), `GET|POST /:id/messages` (2563,2613), `POST /:id/interruption` (2581), `POST /:id/idle` (2657), `POST /:id/media` (2693), soundboard CRUD `GET /soundboard` + `/soundboard/upload` + `/soundboard/:id/file` + `DELETE /soundboard/:id` (2875-2905), and the character/persona video-clip endpoints `GET /character-videos/:characterId` (2253), `/character-videos/:characterId/generate` (2264), `/character-videos/:characterId/custom/generate` (2297), `/character-videos/:characterId/file/:kind` (2419), `/character-videos/:characterId/custom/:clipId/file` (2435) plus the `/persona-videos/*` mirror (2337-2404). Fix: add the `/api/conversation-calls` bullet with a representative subset of these paths.

title: Document Conversation Call character video presence (avatar-based emotion clips)
description: Skill says: character-cards.md 'Sprite System' (lines 153-154) covers only VN expression sprites; nothing about in-call video presence. Reality (2.1): when `callCharacterVideoEnabled` is on (packages/shared/src/types/tts.ts:146, default false) Marinara uses the 'Default for Videos' connection to generate cached avatar-based clips and plays them in-call from TTS cues, returning to idle after speech (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). The six presence clip kinds are fixed: `idle`, `talking`, `laughing`, `angry`, `crying`, `sighing` (packages/shared/src/types/conversation-call.ts:10-26, `CONVERSATION_CALL_CHARACTER_VIDEO_CLIP_KINDS`); each clip has status missing|generating|ready|error and origin generated|uploaded (same file:17,88-97). `callAutomaticVideoClipsEnabled` (tts.ts:148) auto-generates the minimum idle/talking clips. Fix: add a 'Character Video Presence' subsection to character-cards.md describing the six clip kinds, the enable flag, and the Default-for-Videos connection requirement.

title: Document the 'Sprites -> Clips' editor tab (character + persona) and Gallery clips->Videos rename
description: Skill says: character-cards.md 'Sprite System' (lines 153-154) still frames sprites as roleplay expression PNGs only; architecture.md Persona description (lines 42-43) lists no video assets. Reality (2.1): Character AND Persona editors gained a 'Sprites -> Clips' tab for reusable video-call presence clips with standard idle/talking/reaction slots plus named custom call clips (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). Custom clips are capped at 128 per character (`CUSTOM_CLIP_LIMIT = 128`, packages/server/src/services/conversation/call-character-videos.service.ts:115,709). Per-slot generation is available from empty/error clip cards without a full batch (calls.routes.ts:2264,2297). Slots/custom clips accept user-uploaded MP4s and support non-destructive trim points `trimStartSeconds`/`trimEndSeconds` (packages/shared/src/types/conversation-call.ts:95-96,109-110; manifest types 88-121). Gallery 'clips' were also renamed to 'Videos' with Images/Videos tabs. Fix: rewrite/rename the Sprite System section to cover 'Sprites -> Clips', the 128 custom-clip cap, MP4 upload, trim points, and per-slot generation.

title: Document the Video Generation services/providers (Gemini Omni/Veo, xAI, OpenRouter, Seedance)
description: Skill says: architecture.md 'Providers Supported' (lines 164-169) lists text providers and an image-gen row but no video generation. Reality (2.1): a Video Generation subsystem powers call presence clips, animated expressions, and scene videos with services `gemini_omni`, `google_veo`, `xai`, `openrouter`, `seedance` (packages/shared/src/constants/video-generation-defaults.ts:17-23, `VIDEO_DEFAULTS_SERVICES`), each with duration/aspect/resolution defaults (same file:25-54) and features like Veo first/last-frame avatar interpolation and Seedance first/last-frame URL references (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). An 'Advanced > Video Generation' settings panel edits scene-video and call-clip lengths and reusable prompt templates. Fix: add a 'Video Generation' row/subsection to Providers naming these five services and the 'Default for Videos' connection.

title: Document Conversation Call voice input modes (provider-native, Local Whisper, browser speech, manual dictation)
description: Skill says: nothing - SKILL.md and references are silent on call voice input. Reality (2.1): call mic path is selectable via `callAudioInputMode` with four values `system` | `auto` | `transcribe` | `local_whisper` (packages/shared/src/schemas/conversation-call.schema.ts:8; packages/shared/src/types/tts.ts:142, default `local_whisper`). Options: provider-native audio/video when supported, Local Whisper transcription with downloadable Whisper Tiny/Base models, browser speech recognition fallback, and manual system dictation (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). `callVideoInputEnabled` (tts.ts:144, default false) gates the camera/screen UI. Note `callSttConnectionId`/`callSttModel` are now deprecated (tts.ts:137-140). Fix: add a short 'call voice input' note (likely in architecture.md or a new calls subsection) listing the four input modes and the Local Whisper download.

title: Document Conversation Call message reactions and hidden [react]/[custom_clip] call commands
description: Skill says: nothing - the only command-protocol discussion in character-cards.md (lines 98-101) is Professor Mari's private meta-commands. Reality (2.1): in call-only chat, users can react to messages and characters can emit a hidden `[react: emoji="😂"]` (or `[react: emoji=":custom_name:"]`) that reacts to the user's latest written call message (packages/server/src/routes/conversation-calls.routes.ts:734). With Character Video Presence + Custom Clips enabled, characters may sparsely emit `[custom_clip: label="...", prompt="..."]` to generate one custom call clip saved to their Sprites->Clips library (calls.routes.ts:736-740; gated by `callCustomVideoClipsEnabled`, tts.ts:150, and only added to allowed commands when a custom-video connection exists, calls.routes.ts:1060). Character-initiated calls can also include a greeting that plays after the user answers (CHANGELOG [2.1.0]). Fix: add these call commands where conversation command grammar is documented, noting they are engine-emitted and gated, not user-authorable meta-commands.

title: Document character-to-character reactions [react: emoji="..." to "Character Name"] and per-segment merged-reply reactions
description: Skill says: architecture.md Conversation Mode (lines 80-90) lists no reaction system at all. Reality (2.1): in Conversation mode a character can react to the user's latest message with `[react: emoji="😂"]` or to another character with `[react: emoji="🙄" to "Character Name"]`, which posts a badge on that character's most recent message and shows in UI chips and prompt context (packages/server/src/routes/generate.routes.ts:3714; #3210). Reactions can also target an individual character's segment within a merged multi-character reply (per-segment add-reaction buttons + prompt-visible `[User reacted with ...]` notes under the exact segment, #3210). Emoji reactions have their own toggleable 'Reactions' card in the per-command Commands grid (#3219). Fix: add a 'Conversation reactions' bullet to architecture.md and note the `[react: ... to "Name"]` grammar.

title: Add a references pointer / ideation note for calls + video presence
description: Skill says: SKILL.md 'When to consult bundled references' table (lines 63-71) and the Mode A in-app shortcut note (lines 81) mention characters/lorebooks/tools/agents/extensions but nothing about Conversation Calls, character video presence, or the 'Sprites -> Clips' editor - so a user asking 'how do I set up video calls with my character' has no routing. Reality (2.1): calls + video presence are a first-class Conversation feature (CHANGELOG [2.1.0]; packages/server/src/routes/index.ts:89). Fix: add a table row (e.g. 'Conversation audio/video calls, character video presence, Sprites -> Clips') pointing at architecture.md/character-cards.md once those sections are added, and mention that Professor Mari has built-in guidance for call setup (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Changed).

title: Note animated Expression Engine portraits (video-generated looping GIF sprites) alongside the sprite system
description: Skill says: character-cards.md 'Sprite System' (line 154) says 'There's also an automated sprite generation feature (uses image gen + a pose prompt)' - implying still images only. Reality (2.1): portrait sprite generation can now use Video Generation connections to create short expression clips, convert them into looping GIF sprites, and save them into expression slots, with Advanced > Video Generation controls for duration (`animatedExpressionClipDurationSeconds`, default 3s, range 1-8; packages/shared/src/constants/video-generation-settings.ts:12-13,28) and prompt templates (CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added). Fix: extend the sprite-generation sentence to mention video-based animated expression sprites and the duration/template controls.
